note: Controlled benchmark with exact ground truth. The JD and retrieval corpora are generated (real postings carry no labels); the evidence and interview cases are hand-authored. Treat these numbers as indicators of behaviour on this corpus, not as market-representative accuracy.

rag_retrieval.note: samples counts queries; documents counts indexed evidence fragments

evidence_validation.rubric: supported = every substantive element carried by >=2 independent evidence kinds; partially_supported = core action evidenced but one element weaker; unsupported = a substantive element has no support anywhere
evidence_validation.note: Replaced the generated claim corpus, which held 22 distinct claim/kind pairs across 120 rows and therefore measured a template rather than the gate.
